title: Great app
body:
Overall I think the app is really good. It is simple and easy to use which I love. 
The one thing I’d like to see added is the option to make the frequency weekly or monthly without being tied to a specific day. For example if I want to create a habit to go for a hike once a week but the hike doesn’t have to be on a specific day. Or if I have a chore habit that needs to be completed once a month but doesn’t have to be done on a specific day.
